limitations: Scripted sequential interleaving, not simultaneous execution or model decisions.
Fixed synthetic profile and two bounded journals; no private profiles or real providers.
128k declared context avoids intentional pressure; unexpected hidden summaries fail the two-request protocol. Compaction entries are counted, not assumed absent.
Heap/resource trends are diagnostics and include growing receipts/journals; not proof of a leak or its absence.
SIGINT/SIGTERM and turn timeout are failures. Hard watchdog may leave a synthetic temp directory. Setup/restart/final cleanup are outside turn watchdog and require parent supervision if stuck.
